calibration.notes: 2026-08-15: six GPU-shaded cells (material-standard-pbr, effect-radial-blur, and mesh-normal-position-groups on webgl and webgpu) were measured on two independent x86_64 hosts with two runs per host, for 24 observations. All encoded PNG bytes were identical within and across hosts, establishing a zero observed noise floor. Ubuntu release, kernel, Node major, and machine varied; Chromium 149.0.7827.55 / Playwright 1.61.0 / chromium-1228, SwiftShader flags, 800x600 viewport, DPR 1, Etc/UTC timezone, and C/POSIX locale were held constant. per-node-effect-glow-shadow was withheld pending investigation. A different Chromium build and an AVX-512 dispatch path were not tested. The corpus digest covers canonical JSON of the Flight commit and sorted identities as documented in comparison-policies/README.md.
